messages.subject: Issues importing data
parts:
Hello:

I just got my first set of DArT data back and am beginning analysis. I have my 2 column file and my metadata csv but and getting the following error. 

> #importing data
>  gl <- gl.read.dart( filename = "Report_DLasio22-7076_SNP_2.csv",
+                      ind.metafile = "sample_metadata.csv")
Starting gl.read.dart
Starting utils.read.dart
  Topskip not provided.
 Setting topskip to 3 .
  Reading in the SNP data
  Detected 2 row format.
Added the following locus metrics:
AlleleID CloneID AlleleSequence TrimmedSequence Chrom_Vombatus_ursinus_v1 ChromPosTag_Vombatus_ursinus_v1 ChromPosSnp_Vombatus_ursinus_v1 AlnCnt_Vombatus_ursinus_v1 AlnEvalue_Vombatus_ursinus_v1 Strand_Vombatus_ursinus_v1 SNP SnpPosition CallRate OneRatioRef OneRatioSnp FreqHomRef FreqHomSnp FreqHets PICRef PICSnp AvgPIC AvgCountRef AvgCountSnp RepAvg .
Number of rows per clone (should be only  2 s): 2
 Recognised: 91 individuals and 4625  SNPs in a 2 row format using Report_DLasio22-7076_SNP_2.csv
Completed: utils.read.dart
Starting utils.dart2genlight
Starting conversion....
Format is 2 rows.
Please note conversion of bigger data sets will take some time!
Once finished, we recommend to save the object using save(object, file="object.rdata")
Adding individual metrics: sample_metadata.csv .
Individual names are not unique. You need to change them!
Error in utils.dart2genlight(dout, ind.metafile = ind.metafile, probar = probar,  :

I checked all of my id values in my metadata file and my dart file and they are unique. Then after reading through the output I realised that topskip was only set to 3 and my file has 6 rows with * characters. I tried running with the topskip option set to 6 and removing the extra rows but got the following error. 

> #importing data
>  gl <- gl.read.dart( filename = "Report_DLasio22-7076_SNP_2.csv",
+                      ind.metafile = "sample_metadata.csv", topskip = 6)
Starting gl.read.dart
Starting utils.read.dart
  Reading in the SNP data
Error in utils.read.dart(filename = filename, nas = nas, topskip = topskip,  :
  object 'tdummy' not found

Any assistance would be greatly appreciated!

Cheers, 

Colin Sobek

messages.author: 592079bda2cb3220
messages.subject: Re: Issues importing data
parts:
Hi Colin,

Based on the information you sent me, I found that the problem was that the names in your metadata file were not the same as in the DArT report.
I have reformatted the names of your samples. Please use the attached file for your metadata information and try again to run the function gl.read.dart().

> library(dartR)
> gl <- gl.read.dart( filename = "Report_DLasio22-7076_SNP_2.csv",  ind.metafile = "sample_metadata.csv")

Cheers,
Luis
